Two supply lines keep Gambell running: food hunted on the sea ice under a federal permission and village limits, and food, fuel and freight that arrive by plane and barge at a price. In 2020 a failed fuel barge meant gasoline rationing; in 2013 rough weather emptied the freezers. Which line would you protect first if you lived here, the hunt or the store? And should the limits on walrus hunting be set mainly by the villages, or by federal agencies? Tell us below. 👇
